ModMetaData.name: Essencebound v0.10 — RimWorld 1.7
ModMetaData.author: Essencebound Project
ModMetaData.description: Essencebound v0.10 experimental RimWorld 1.7 prototype: a four-essence character profile, configurable 2-5 ability slots per essence, innate starter powers, awakening stones, and universal pawn targeting. Requires Essencebound.Core.dll in 1.7/Assemblies. Use test saves and report errors.
